1879231214.desc: This horn will summon Brúngwath and his shades to your aid.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>NOTE: This item may only be used at the appropriate time during the Brown Lands instance A Sunset Storm.</rgb>

Though inaccurate, each successful strike with this skill will increase your chance to hit and your chance to score a critical strike against a target. You can gain these benefits up to 5 times. A succssful critical hit will dispel all stacked effects.

1879250030.name: Staggering Slash
1879250030.desc: A brutal strike against rider and steed, this slash is meant to weaken your enemy, leaving them susceptible to further attack.

1879270510.name: Barrage
1879270510.desc: A quick attack that deals more damage each time it is used.

 Finishers deal increased damage.</rgb>

1879470574.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879470574.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline focuses on the swashbuckling nature of the Mariner, allowing for larger risks and greater results.
